Select IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human FLT3. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Join compound_records to retrieve compound_key. Join docs to retrieve pubmed_id_or_doi. Filter by target_dictionary.pref_name = 'FLT3' and target_dictionary.organism = 'Homo sapiens' and activities.standard_type = 'IC50'. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Do not deduplicate rows. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
